segments.an3.118:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti … pe … samphappalāpī hoti.
segments.an3.118:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti byāpannacitto.
segments.an3.118:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano –
segments.an3.118:4.3: ‘natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ … pe … ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
segments.an3.118:4.5: Sīlavipattihetu vā, bhikkhave … pe … diṭṭhivipattihetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.an3.118:4.6: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, apaṇṇako maṇi uddhaṃ khitto yena yeneva patiṭṭhāti suppatiṭṭhitaṃyeva patiṭṭhāti;
segments.an3.118:4.7: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sīlavipattihetu vā sattā … pe … upapajjanti.
segments.an3.118:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe …
segments.an3.118:7.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco anabhijjhālu hoti abyāpannacitto.
segments.an3.118:8.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano –
segments.an3.118:8.3: ‘atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ … pe … ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
segments.an3.118:8.5: Sīlasampadāhetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. Cittasampadāhetu vā … pe … diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.an3.118:8.6: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, apaṇṇako maṇi uddhaṃ khitto yena yeneva patiṭṭhāti suppatiṭṭhitaṃyeva patiṭṭhāti;
segments.an3.118:8.7: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sīlasampadāhetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti, cittasampadāhetu vā sattā … pe … diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe apaṇṇako maṇīti chahi talehi samannāgato pāsako.
Imasmiṃ sutte sīlañca sammādiṭṭhi cāti ubhayampi missakaṃ kathitaṃ.
119-120. Chaṭṭhe chahi talehi samannāgato pāsakoti catūsu passesu cattāri talāni, dvīsu koṭīsu dve talānīti evaṃ chahi talehi samannāgato pāsakakīḷāpasutānaṃ maṇisadiso pāsakaviseso.
